events.title: NAIDOC Week Botanical Eco-Printing & Dot Art Workshops
events.location: Coolum, Kawana, Caloundra, Nambour & Maroochydore Libraries
events.description: Celebrate NAIDOC Week with hands-on workshops at various libraries. Participants can learn botanical eco-printing to discover natural colours and explore Aboriginal storytelling traditions through dot art.

events.title: NAIDOC: LORE | Land – Exhibition
events.description: An exhibition grounded in the deep cultural knowledge, ancestral connections, and sovereign rights of Australian First Nations peoples, running at Caloundra Regional Gallery through August 16.

events.title: GATHAA First Nations Markets
events.datetime: Various dates across Mon 6 – Sun 12 July
events.location: TBC (Sunshine Coast – venues to be announced)
events.description: Vibrant markets and gatherings celebrating "50 Years of Deadly" during NAIDOC Week, featuring First Nations businesses, live music, cultural performances, bushfood experiences, and creative workshops.

events.title: Festival of the Harvest – Free NAIDOC Celebration
events.location: Kabi Kabi Country, Sunshine Coast (specific location TBC)
events.description: A free NAIDOC celebration hosted by Undumbi Culture on Kabi Kabi Country, featuring music, dance, storytelling, bush tucker, hands-on cultural experiences, Indigenous markets, and kids' activities like art and face painting.

events.title: Dreaming Collective Sunshine Coast NAIDOC Gala
events.location: The Shed, Aussie World, Sunshine Coast
events.description: A special evening celebrating "50 Years of Deadly" and the strength, resilience, and cultural brilliance of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, featuring live performances, arts, awards, and a two-course dinner.

events.title: Noosa Arts Theatre – Annual One-Act Play Festival
events.description: The annual festival producing the top three plays from the National One-Act Playwriting Competition, offering short plays from local and national playwrights in a fantastic community theatre event.

events.title: Cinderella – Youth Edition
events.datetime: Fri 10 July, 11:00 AM & 2:30 PM; Sat 11 July, 11:00 AM & 2:30 PM
events.description: A beloved musical reimagining the classic fairy tale with humour, heart, and unforgettable songs, brought to life by a talented cast of young performers from Little Seed Theatre Company.

events.title: Silent Film Screening: The Last of the Mohicans (1920)
events.description: Experience a silent film in an authentic way with a live organist accompanying the 1920 classic "The Last of the Mohicans", at a theatre housing a rare 1937 Compton Organ.

events.title: Livin' Lovin' Zeppelin – Live
events.description: A live band, fronted by Tara Graham, performs the eternal anthems of Led Zeppelin, rocking through their biggest tunes at the historic Majestic Theatre.

events.title: Australian Wearable Art Festival – Gala Night
events.location: Novotel Twin Waters Resort, Twin Waters
events.source: The Urban List / Sunshine Coast Council
events.description: The Gala Night of the Australian Wearable Art Festival, showcasing bold new themes, sublime garments, and dazzling creations on a 27-metre runway, along with hands-on workshops and a gallery exhibition.

events.title: NAIDOC Week Library Events – Daily Programme
events.description: An ongoing daily programme across multiple library branches for NAIDOC Week 2026, featuring curated book displays, drop-in activities, and cultural programming celebrating "50 Years of Deadly."
